```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## R Markdown

```{r setting up data}
bankdata <-read_csv2("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/bankData.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename("Subscription" = y) %>%
    filter(age < 75, marital != "unknown")
```

```{r making graphs}
p1 <-ggplot(data = bankdata, aes(x = duration)) 
p1+ geom_density(alpha = 0.2, aes( fill = loan) ) +
      xlim(0, 1500)

```

```{r}
p1 <-ggplot(data = bankdata, aes(x = duration, y =marital)) 
p1+ geom_boxplot() +
        xlim(0, 5000) 
```


```{r}
g <- ggplot(msleep, aes( x= awake, y = vore))
g + boxplot(x = msleep$awake, y = msleep$vore)
```
